{{Spoiler}}

'''Sweet berry toast''' is a secret meal of [[sweet berries]]. It heals {{Hp|10}} and grants {{EffectLink|Health Boost}} II for 8 minutes.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/sweet_berry_toast.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
Raw sweet berries, an egg, sugar, estus ash and bread (or naan). The recipe is taught by a [[Cooking Recipe]] sold by a Novice [[Cook]].
{{Sources}}

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating it takes 1.8 seconds, heals {{Hp|10}} and gives Health Boost II for 8:00. Making it grants ''Wait, you can make that?''

=== Cook ===
A Novice Cook sells 8 sweet berry toast for 1 [[obol]].
